summary: Mission Produce filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing execution of a $100 million stock repurchase program authorized June 8, 2026. During Q3 to-date, the company repurchased 641,342 shares at an average price of $11.27 per share. The board authorized the program; no advisors named. The buyback is open-market, reducing share count by about 2% of outstanding. Watch for pace of further repurchases and impact on EPS.
